FROM PRINCIPLES TO PRACTICE

A framework you can put to work.

A policy matters when someone can act on it. KDV connects what you want to govern, who can decide, how work flows and what demonstrates that it works.

01

Name the responsibility

Make domain, subdomain and product ownership explicit.

02

Make the work repeatable

Use agreed processes, versioned contracts and practical decision gates.

03

Keep the evidence

Connect decisions, controls, tests and outcomes so that improvement can be observed.

BIO-INSPIRED BY DESIGN

Different roles.
A shared ecosystem.

Hives and beekeeping give us a language for cooperation, local responsibility and care for the whole. It is an organisational metaphor: people, decision rights and data products remain explicit.

Explore the operating model↗

THE OPERATING MODEL

Five layers. One traceable thread.

Follow a decision from intent to evidence. Each layer gives the next one something concrete to work with.

01

Principles & policies

What must hold true

Purpose, classification, retention and the minimum governance baseline.

↓
02

Organisation & roles

Who decides and delivers

Explicit owners and stewards, with responsibilities assigned at the right scope.

↓
03

Processes & decisions

How work moves

Cultivate, govern, share and activate, with review and exception paths.

↓
04

Controls & enablers

How rules take effect

Contracts, quality checks, access policies, catalogues and operational safeguards.

↓
05

Evidence & improvement

How we know and learn

Decision records, test results, usage, incidents and agreed outcome measures.

↺
See roles and reference mapping↗

THE DATA JOURNEY

From a useful question
to a useful data product.

Start small. Define a purpose, follow the four stages and use feedback to improve the next iteration.

01

Cultivate

Prepare with purpose.

→02

Govern

Make trust actionable.

→03

Share

Publish an agreement.

→04

Activate

Observe the value.

→

A common baseline. Local decisions.

Every shared product needs ownership, a contract, a classification, policy-based access and an audit trail. Each ecosystem adapts role names, approval routes, thresholds and review cadences around that minimum.

  • Named ownership
  • Versioned contract
  • Classification
  • Access by policy
  • Auditability

Community

Help shape the next iteration.

Bring a question, a better example or a tested improvement. Small contributions count.
